about_the_game:
About this software

Image2pixel is a pixel art generator tool that allows you to convert input images into pixel art sketches.

Features

  • Enter a picture to view the pixel sketch effect in real time

  • Create an image based on the color mode of the input image

  • Support input gif

  • Pixel art adjustment parameters: BlockSize, Colors
detailed_description:
About this software

Image2pixel is a pixel art generator tool that allows you to convert input images into pixel art sketches.

Features

  • Enter a picture to view the pixel sketch effect in real time

  • Create an image based on the color mode of the input image

  • Support input gif

  • Pixel art adjustment parameters: BlockSize, Colors
